name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: An Agent Skill Marketplace designed to audit a brand's visibility, alignment, and optimization for Generative AI search engines, RAG systems, and LLMs.

skills.name: audit-orchestrator
skills.description: Coordinative skill that orchestrates the execution flow of the Brand AI Readiness Audit, invoking domain skills sequentially, aggregate findings, and generating a unified score.

skills.name: offsite-discoverability
skills.description: Evaluates a brand's technical and crawlers discoverability across AI search engines, public datasets, and API endpoints.

skills.name: semantic-readiness
skills.description: Assesses semantic density, entity relationships, Schema.org structure, and context chunkability for LLM context windows.

skills.name: offsite-corroboration
skills.description: Audits fact consistency, entity resolution, and public sentiment alignment across third-party sources (Wikipedia, reviews, directory networks).

skills.name: engagement-audit
skills.description: Measures brand presence, sentiment, and reference frequencies within LLM prompts, chat responses, and generative engine results.
